purpose: Test whether a public service-envelope relation-value actor resolves the V8 branch conflict beyond a capacity-matched ordinary MLP, and whether its field correspondence matters.

fixed_algorithm.observation: identical legal V8 public observation across all arms

predeclared_gate.candidate_control_signal: balanced success improvement >= 0.10 OR balanced timeout reduction >= 0.10, while collision increase <= 0.05
predeclared_gate.semantic_degradation_signal: aligned minus shuffle branch accuracy >= 0.15 OR balanced success >= 0.10

stop_rule: If the predeclared G3 pilot gate fails, preserve the artifact and diagnose the structural failure. Do not tune thresholds, seeds, reward, or candidate fields after observing the pilot.
